An old website archived on WayBack.archive. It used to be a website called ButterflyCooking.web. It used to be a home cooking blog by someone who went by "ButterflyWitch". The meals are usually affordable and decent. The recipes also came with cooking videos, but those are lost media.

Foundry notes:

  • Setting flavor: no rules effect.
